title: Requests to disable or adjust warnings and settings
summary: This topic centers on customers asking whether specific alerts, warnings, screens, or behaviors can be disabled or adjusted, with most examples not expressing a clear evaluative sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review reflects relief that a setting could be disabled or modified to better match customer preference.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly describe requests for disabling features, uncertainty about whether settings can be changed, or walkthroughs on locating those settings without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
The topic mixes several feature types, including warnings, screens, and general behavior settings, so the cluster is not fully specific.
Examples describe customer requests and service-writer guidance, but they often do not identify the exact feature involved.
